module: Particle editor ("Particle Editor" edit mode) of the world editor. It adds a header to the inspector with an Emitter tab (choose, create, save, delete a ParticleEmitterData) and a tab for the attached ParticleData. It also registers two custom field editors: "particles" (up to 4 ParticleData, separated by tabs) for ParticleEmitterData and "textureName" (file picker) for ParticleData. The datablocks are saved in art/shapes/particles/managedParticleEmitterData.json and managedParticleData.json, either in their original file or in the current level's folder.
notes: The module only exports hooks; all the logic (undo/redo of creation and deletion, saving, confirmation of unsaved change) is local.
An emitter named "DefaultEmitter" is protected: the editing buttons are disabled for it.
The windows only act if editor.editMode is the particleEditMode mode.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Called once the editor is initialized. Declares the edit mode editor.editModes.particleEditMode (name "Particle Editor") and registers the custom field editors for ParticleEmitterData.particles and ParticleData.textureName.

onEditorInspectorFieldChanged.desc: Called when an inspector field is modified. If the modified object (selectedIds[1]) is the current emitter or particle, the datablock is marked dirty, reloaded (reload) and the datablocks list is rebuilt.

selectedIds.desc: Ids of the selected objects; only the first is used.

onEditorInspectorHeaderGui.desc: Called every frame at the start of the Inspector window. Draws the Emitter / Particle tabs, the new, save, save in level, delete buttons, and the confirmation box for a selection change with unsaved modifications. Does nothing outside Particle Editor mode.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension loads; only writes "initialized" to the log (level D).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Called on unload; deletes the preview emitter node (editableEmitterNode) if it exists.
